facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates about 4 live commercial data centre facilities in Rwanda in 2024, with about 1MW live IT load and about 60% occupancy by third-party customers; facilities are mostly hybrid, leasing excess capacity to external customers, and none are named.
Xalam Analytics lists AOS, a state agency, among Rwanda's market players as offering IT services including colocation to outside customers, in its 2024 estimates.

note: No Tier III facility or cloud region stated; the brief says no pure-play carrier-neutral provider existed in 2024.
